rationale: Eggerthella lenta is a saccharolytic anaerobe that ferments glucose and amino acids to acetate, formate, and CO₂. Abundant glucose (24.71 mM) and arginine (21.67 mM) support mixed-acid fermentation. Glucose provides primary carbon and energy; arginine supplies nitrogen and secondary carbon. Cysteine uptake provides sulfur. Fermentation products (acetate, formate, CO₂) balance carbon and redox. Growth rate 0.080 /h is conservative, consistent with recent turns 2–3 and supported by available substrate.
